tagline: 柯尼卡取景器相机，1989 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1989年推出的取景器相机。配备Konica Lens 34mm F4.5 (3 elements in 3 groups)。快门速度1/125 sec. (fixed speed)。感光度ISO 100/200/400 ({DX coding)。Focus free (fixed focus), 1.5 m - infinity。

specs.镜头: Konica Lens 34mm F4.5 (3 elements in 3 groups)
specs.曝光测光: Fixed exposure; an aperture is selected according to the film speed.
specs.闪光灯: G.N.14 m (ISO100), automatically activated, no flash-off facility
specs.英文简介: The Konica Manbow Woo is a weatherproof compact camera released by the Japanese manufacturer Konica in 1989.
